title: Show column statistics in `st.dataframe`
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests. - [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue. ### Summary Show per-column summary statistics (e.g. count, mean, min/max, unique values, missing values) directly in the table UI of `st.dataframe` so users can quickly understand their data’s distribution without writing extra code or exporting to other tools. ### How? Just show the statistics/visualisation inside the column menu. ### Additional Context - Prototype: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11323 - Related issue: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/6863
